description: A sleek, tall over-the-knee boot with a pointed toe and stiletto heel, constructed from black leather with a contrasting vertical white woven panel running down the outer side. The silhouette is elongating and streamlined, emphasizing a modern, minimalist aesthetic with clean lines and a sharp, architectural profile.

Stiletto-heel mid-calf boot with round-toe, constructed from black sequined fabric with a contrasting velvet panel down the center. The design emphasizes a glamorous, evening-ready silhouette with a high-shine, textured surface that catches light. The ankle-high cut and slender heel create a elongating, sophisticated profile.

A sleek, ankle-length boot with a glossy, textured black patent leather finish and a pointed toe. Features a moderate comma heel and a single adjustable buckle strap at the ankle for a secure fit. The sculpted silhouette and reflective surface create a dramatic, evening-ready profile.

A bold, bright yellow ankle boot featuring a sculpted, ruched upper with horizontal pleats and a sharply pointed toe. Constructed from a smooth, satin-like fabric, it is elevated by a slender, metallic comma heel with a black cap. The design emphasizes a modern, architectural silhouette with a minimalist aesthetic.

A sleek, olive-green kitten-heel mule sandal with a low kitten heel and a minimalist slip-on silhouette. The upper is crafted from smooth leather with a decorative flap closure featuring two metallic circular embellishments. The design combines clean lines with subtle hardware accents for a modern, chic aesthetic.

A vibrant yellow patent leather sandal featuring a slender metallic kitten heel and multiple adjustable straps with silver-toned circular hardware accents. The design includes a peep-toe silhouette and a contoured footbed, offering a bold, eye-catching profile with a glossy finish.

A lime-green patent leather slide sandal featuring a wide strap with two metallic circular embellishments over the instep. The shoe has a flat, contoured sole with a contrasting dark outsole and a minimalist, slip-on construction. The glossy finish and bold color give it a chic, modern profile.

A sleek, glossy black patent leather slide sandal with a flat, molded sole and a single wide strap across the vamp. The strap is adorned with two prominent, circular silver-toned metal studs as embellishments. The silhouette is minimalist and modern, designed for easy slip-on wear with a smooth, continuous upper.

A black suede mule featuring a slender kitten heel and a single strap across the vamp adorned with a cluster of sparkling crystal and iridescent embellishments. The silhouette is minimalist with open back, designed for a sleek, evening-ready profile.

A black suede peep-toe pump featuring a distinctive wraparound ankle strap with a tied bow, accented by transparent acrylic crisscross straps over the instep. The shoe has a medium-height comma heel and a pointed toe silhouette, creating a sleek, elegant profile.

A single pink mule sandal with a distinctive spherical metallic heel and a minimalist open-toe design. The upper is crafted from a matte pink suede-like material, featuring a wide, continuous strap across the vamp. The heel is a low, sculpted block with a polished silver metallic finish, contrasting with the soft pink upper.

A sleek, metallic silver sandal featuring a slender kitten heel and a minimalist open-toe design with a single strap across the vamp. The ankle is secured by a black elasticated band with a white stripe and a zipper closure for ease of wear. The upper is crafted from a textured, metallic leather-like material, giving it a modern, reflective finish.

A sleek black suede pump featuring a pointed toe and a slender comma heel. The design includes a distinctive wrap-around lace-up closure at the ankle for a secure fit and a modern silhouette. The interior lining appears to be a contrasting light tone, enhancing comfort and visual contrast.

A minimalist white pump featuring a pointed toe, a slender kitten heel, and a distinctive rear zipper closure for ease of wear. The upper is crafted from smooth white leather with a subtle pebbled texture, and the interior lining appears to be a contrasting tan material. The design emphasizes clean lines and functional elegance.

A sleek, glossy black over-the-knee boot with a pointed toe and a thin stiletto heel. The boot features a bold vertical stripe of magenta and red running down the outer side, set against the patent leather finish. The silhouette is elongated and form-fitting, extending above the knee with a smooth, high-shine surface.

A sleek, black leather thigh-high boot with a pointed toe and stiletto heel, accented by a bold vertical white stripe running down the outer side. The silhouette is elongated and form-fitting, with a smooth, glossy finish and a minimalist design emphasizing clean lines and contrast.

A sleek ankle boot with a metallic silver leather upper and a pointed toe, accented by bold black and white vertical stripes along the shaft. Features a thin, metallic kitten heel and a minimalist, modern silhouette with a smooth, textured finish.

A glamorous, metallic silver stiletto-heel sandal with a transparent strap structure adorned with crystal embellishments. The shoe features a pointed toe and a slender, stiletto heel encrusted with crystals, creating a high-shine, evening-ready silhouette. Constructed with clear straps and a reflective metallic finish, it emphasizes a bold, sparkling aesthetic.

A vibrant pink suede-effect sandal featuring a sculpted, multi-toned block heel with metallic silver and white textured details. The upper is constructed with multiple crisscrossing straps, including a thin ankle strap with a knotted end, creating a strappy, open-toe silhouette. The sole is white with a scalloped edge and a black rubberized heel cap.

A sleek, modern mule featuring a peep-toe silhouette with a contrasting navy blue stiletto heel and matching insole. Constructed from a textured navy fabric with visible hand-stitched detailing along the vamp, the shoe combines minimalist design with a bold heel accent. The open-back mule style offers a streamlined, elegant profile.

A minimalist white mule featuring a sleek, open-toe silhouette with a slender, metallic stiletto heel and contrasting black sole. The upper is crafted from smooth leather with decorative perforated stitching along the vamp, emphasizing clean lines and modern tailoring. The design combines a peep-toe cut with a slip-on construction for a chic, effortless look.

A vibrant pink suede platform sandal featuring a thick, natural cork block heel and matching cork platform sole. The design includes multiple thin straps across the vamp and a wide, adjustable ankle wrap with a decorative bow. The silhouette is bold and elevated, combining platform construction with a high heel for maximum height.

A white platform sandal featuring a thick block heel and a peep-toe design with multiple thin straps wrapping around the ankle and forefoot, secured with a tied bow. The silhouette is bold and architectural, with a substantial platform sole and clean, minimalist lines. Constructed from a smooth, white material with a subtle sheen, likely synthetic-leather or patent.

A black mule sandal featuring a sculpted block heel with vertical ridges and a glossy finish, paired with a textured, woven strap across the instep and a matching toe strap. The sole has a ribbed, chunky profile, and the overall silhouette is modern and architectural. The material appears to be a synthetic-leather or patent-like finish with a woven overlay.

A single pink patent leather mule featuring a distinctive spherical, low-profile heel and a minimalist thong-style strap configuration. The glossy finish and bold color create a modern, sculptural silhouette with a flat heel base and a rounded toe. The construction includes a contrasting light-colored insole and a sleek, continuous strap design.

A minimalist black patent leather mule featuring a distinctive spherical block heel and a single thong strap with a knot detail at the instep. The silhouette is sleek and modern with a square toe and a glossy finish, emphasizing clean lines and contemporary design.

A black suede slingback pump featuring a pointed toe and a slender stiletto heel. The design is accentuated by a decorative crystal-embellished strap that crosses the instep and a matching adjustable ankle strap with a silver buckle. The transparent heel cap adds a modern, architectural detail.

A sleek, pointed-toe pump in a vibrant royal blue, crafted from a matte-finish fabric with a contrasting black stiletto heel and black sole. The silhouette is classic and streamlined, featuring a closed back and a smooth, uninterrupted upper with no visible embellishments or hardware.

A bold cobalt blue suede wedge shoe with contrasting black lacing and trim, featuring a slip-on construction with a reinforced toe cap and a white rubber sole. Constructed with lace-up closure and a sculpted wedge heel, it combines casual sneaker styling with elevated height. The design emphasizes a clean, minimalist silhouette with a pointed toe and subtle tonal contrast.

A vibrant fuchsia satin ankle boot featuring a pointed toe and a slender kitten heel. The boot is accented with a decorative crystal-embellished strap across the ankle, fastened with a silver-toned buckle. The sleek, form-fitting silhouette and glossy material create a glamorous, eye-catching profile.

A sleek, tall  knee-high boot with a round toe and a block heel, crafted from grey suede with a contrasting light blue vertical seam detail along the inner leg. The silhouette is straight and minimalist, emphasizing clean lines and a modern, sophisticated profile.

A glossy black patent leather pump featuring a pointed toe and a slender stiletto heel. A sleek, black over-the-knee boot with a pointed toe and a low block heel. Constructed from smooth leather with a minimalist silhouette, featuring a subtle seam detail at the upper shaft and a concealed closure. The design emphasizes elongation and a modern, chic aesthetic.

A vibrant fuchsia mule sandal with a flat, contoured sole and a wide strap across the vamp secured by a square gold-tone metal plate.
